Title: End-to-end Guest Checkout flow for an eligible delivery listing (<= $300)
Preconditions: Logged-out visitor views a fixed-price, delivery-enabled listing priced at $100 with $15 delivery fee (Total $115).
Steps:
1. Tap 'Buy now'.
2. Select 'Continue as guest'.
3. Enter valid email, full name, phone, and delivery address.
4. Enter valid Visa/Mastercard details, review order summary ($100 + $15 = $115), and tap 'Pay'.
5. Complete 3-D Secure verification.
Expected Result: Order succeeds, confirmation screen shows order number and optional 'Create account' prompt pre-filled with email, confirmation email with unauthenticated 'Track order' link is sent, listing becomes 'Sold', and seller sees order from 'Guest buyer' + entered name.

Title: Guest Checkout eligibility and total cap (> $300 hides 'Continue as guest')
Preconditions: Listings exist: (A) Delivery + Fixed price, total $301 ($290 + $11 fee); (B) Meetup-only listing ($50); (C) Listing allowing offers ($50).
Steps:
1. As a logged-out visitor, tap 'Buy now' on Listing A ($301 total).
2. Check checkout options on Listing B (Meetup-only) and Listing C (Offers enabled).
Expected Result: On Listing A (total > $300), 'Continue as guest' is hidden and only 'Log in' is displayed. Meetup-only and offer-based listings do not offer Guest Checkout.
Requirement: Guest Checkout - Scope & Cap (§2, §4) — CONFLICT with §1 ($500)

Title: Guest Checkout rate limit: 4th order within 24 hours for the same email is blocked
Preconditions: A specific email address has already completed 3 guest orders within the last 24 hours.
Steps: 1. As a guest, attempt to place a 4th order using the same email address.
Expected Result: 4th order attempt is blocked with message: 'You've reached the guest order limit. Log in or create an account to continue.'

Title: Failed 3-D Secure card challenge prevents order creation
Preconditions: Guest is on the payment step of an eligible delivery listing.
Steps:
1. Enter card details and tap 'Pay'.
2. Fail or cancel the 3-D Secure authentication challenge.
Expected Result: Error 'Payment could not be verified. Try another card.' is displayed, no order is created, and listing remains 'Available'.

Title: Post-purchase account creation links guest order and unauthenticated Track Order link works
Preconditions: Guest just completed an order with email 'guest@example.com'.
Steps:
1. Click the 'Track order' link in the confirmation email in an incognito browser.
2. On the post-purchase screen, complete the pre-filled 'Create account' flow for 'guest@example.com'.
3. View Order History in the newly created account.
Expected Result: 'Track order' link opens the order's tracking page without requiring login; newly created account automatically shows the guest order linked in Order History.
